race.comment: SURFERS ROYALE (7) is the clear danger after finishing second in the same race, beaten just under a length as the odds-on favourite, and his recent sequence of placings reads well enough to go close again. SOOPAT (1) has to rebound from a last placing at Emerald, but he was slow away and wide throughout there, and his record at this track keeps him firmly in the mix. PENNYPACKER (8) was much better than the market expected first-up at Townsville, closing into fifth from big odds in a BM70, and the easier meeting plus proven track-and-trip profile make him a genuine hope. DEMITASSE (6) was much better last start here in this grade and warrants a close eye in betting.
